Body.Content:
Reduce manual work and support accurate excise duty handling by applying bonded-location rules to inventory. Designate warehouses or storage locations as bonded so excise duties can be deferred while goods remain in bonded storage and assessed when goods move to non-bonded locations or enter taxable circulation, according to configured tax rules.

Benefits

• Configure specific warehouses or storage locations for bonded inventory and deferred excise duty treatment.

• Account for bonded location status when calculating excise duties on inventory transactions.

• Automatically assess duties when goods leave bonded storage or enter taxable circulation.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
